items.title: 'I was their slave': ISIS-linked Australians charged with crimes against humanity
items.description: The ABC can reveal new detail about the alleged treatment of a Yazidi woman who says she was held captive in the home of ISIS-linked Australians in Syria, including two women who are now facing slave-related charges.

items.title: Live: US and Iran reportedly exchange fire in Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran's semi-official news agency is reporting Tehran's navy has targeted three US destroyers in the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: US trade court rules against Trump's 10pc tariff rate
items.description: A United States trade court rules against President Donald Trump's universal 10 per cent tariff rate, dealing another blow to his signature economic policy.

items.title: Australia on cusp of housing downturn as demand softens
items.description: The tight supply conditions that have underpinned the national housing market in recent years are starting to ease, according to property data firm Cotality.

items.title: What the tax reform duo could mean for renters
items.description: With changes to negative gearing and capital gains tax coming in this year's federal budget, we spoke to three experts who explained how this will impact rental prices.

items.title: Removing capital gains tax discount will be 'disastrous' for startups
items.description: Some entrepreneurs argue any changes to reduce the capital gains tax discount should carve out the start-up sector. However, tax experts warn this would create too much complexity in an already complicated tax system.

items.title: Trump wanted an American pope but not this American pope
items.description: Foreign leaders and lobbyists thought they would write the next chapter in Catholic history. They failed and Leo is proving to be the pope that some of them feared.

items.title: Live: Nationals leader concedes it will be an 'uphill battle' to win Farrer by-election
items.description: Voters in the federal seat of Farrer will head to the polls tomorrow to chose a replacement for former opposition leader Sussan Ley but Matt Canavan says it will be an uphill battle for the Nationals to win back. Follow live.

items.title: Push to stop DV perpetrators financially benefiting from super payouts
items.description: The federal government is reviewing superannuation laws that could see retirement savings paid to domestic violence perpetrators. But industry experts are worried the draft policy reform could only make matters worse.

items.title: The Farrer result will set off willy-willy of spin. The budget already has
items.description: The run-up to a budget always sees a degree of chaos. But this year it has looked like one of those willy-willies that blow up in outback Australia when the wind stirs a storm of dust.

items.title: Sir David Attenborough turns 100: Celebrate his life in his words
items.description: Natural history broadcaster Sir David Attenborough turns 100 today. We look back at his work and interviews to capture some of his wisdom and endless sense of wonder.

items.title: Family battling cancer relies on donations to pay for in-home child care
items.description: The government is accused of breaking its promise of cheaper child care, with prices rising for 810 vulnerable families.

items.title: Bin night across Australia is changing as councils, households fight waste
items.description: How councils collect rubbish is changing as the cost of disposing of waste skyrockets and they scramble to meet environmental targets.

items.title: Why Russian nuclear reactors are spreading around the world
items.description: Russia is building nuclear power plants across the globe, and it's helping it build a network of dependence.

items.title: After 8 years, decision on $30b gas project off WA coast looms
items.description: Woodside's proposal to open up Australia's largest untapped gas resource, the Browse Basin, could be handed to the environment minister for a final decision as soon as next month.

items.title: How do you heal the mother wound?
items.description: It's the yearning ache that comes from reckoning with the imperfect human mother we get, against the idealised fantasy version we wish for.

items.title: ABC weekly news quiz: A stranded ship, an underwhelming space show and a Met movie moment
items.description: Don't bother looking up at the sky, it won't be worth it. Instead, try your luck testing your news knowledge from the past week.

items.title: Urzila Carlson thinks your mum is funny, and you should too
items.description: Urzila Carlson's start in comedy was an accident, but now the stand-up regular is bringing sketch comedy to our TV screens.

items.title: SA teacher who lost long service leave while caring for son says system disadvantages women
items.description: A break in service of just over three months to look after her baby son meant contract teacher Rachel Toyer was ineligible for long-service leave. The department has since clarified its rules, allowing for a 15-month break for parental leave.

items.title: Husband of woman allegedly murdered overseas accused of forging her death certificate
items.description: The estranged husband of an Australian woman, who police suspect was murdered overseas, has been charged in Brisbane after allegedly forging her death certificate.

items.title: Federal government to contribute nearly $4b extra to Victoria's Suburban Rail Loop
items.description: The federal government's contribution to Victoria's most expensive project in history has risen to $6 billion but falls short of the state government's request.

items.title: Short-stay levy passes Tasmania's lower house with support of everyone except Labor
items.description: Tasmania is one step closer to introducing a levy on short-stay accommodation, after legislation passed the lower house. But a push from the crossbench to direct the funds to crisis accommodation and homelessness services has failed.

items.title: Where have Tasmania's rentals gone? New graph highlights housing problem
items.description: A recent housing report highlighted an alarming statistic: Tasmania has less than half the number of vacant rentals than it did a decade ago. So what's behind the decrease?

items.title: Smashed by 1,000 points in four matches, these Dogs are refusing to lie down
items.description: The Dennington Bulldogs are a 117-year-old club that some fear might not make it to 118. But there's more to the Bulldogs' beltings this season than meets the eye.

items.title: Ukraine launches major drone attack amid rows over Victory Day ceasefire
items.description: The Kremlin is taking extraordinary measures ahead of Russia's marking of the defeat of Nazi Germany, as Ukraine launches its second-biggest attack of the war so far.
